name: find-artifacts
description: Scans manuscript text for draft-merge damage: exact-duplicate paragraphs, near-duplicate paragraphs pasted in from a variant draft, truncated false-start paragraphs, and lines with unbalanced markdown-italic asterisks. Returns ranked CANDIDATES only — it never edits text and never decides that something is broken, because short repeated lines are often an intentional refrain, not damage. Call this before apply-fixes whenever a manuscript may have been assembled from multiple draft passes, then have a human or model judge each candidate.

text.description: Full manuscript text, one paragraph per non-empty line (matches the source manuscript's line model).

window.description: Sliding-window size (in paragraphs) for near-duplicate scanning. Defaults to 10.

paragraphs.description: Total number of paragraphs (non-empty, non-heading lines) scanned.

index.description: 0-based position of this candidate in the ranked list.

line.description: Primary 1-based source line number for this candidate.

detail.description: Kind-specific evidence: lines, tag (likely-artifact | maybe-refrain), and similarity/words/flags/snippet2 depending on kind.
